_comment: T10 integrated-grounding config (PINNED — editable-install propagation hazard). Matches the T6 grounding config (grounding_metrics_v0.json) EXACTLY so the only difference vs T6 is the WIDENED input set: this is the clean comparison the redirect needs. Keys are engine.py argparse dests; a CLI flag overrides a field only if left at its argparse default. CORPUS FINDING (T10): the MSE (ams) current/q half of the locked internal-core set is unrealizable from level-1 (static a-coefficient geometry table, not gamma(t)); only the Thomson p-prime half is wired (pressure-only internal grounding). See statespace/integrated_inputs.py + the T10 verdict.
_shot_caps_comment: Same shot budgets as the T6 grounding run (500/300/200) so the train-window count + runtime are comparable to T6 (~24 min CPU) and the integrated-vs-T6 comparison is clean (only the input set changes, not the corpus scale). The persisted split is the full locked core_internal (train=3757 cal=512 ood=128); the run subsamples within it exactly as T6 subsampled within the v0 split. The full 4397-shot load is ~64 min single-threaded I/O — out of the focused-run budget; a full-corpus rerun is a queued lift.
